Square : Four :: ?
questions.solution:
Logic is "Shape : Number of sides".

Square : Four ⇒ A square is a shape that has four sides.

Similarily,

Rectangle : Four ⇒ A rectangle is a shape that also has four sides.

Therefore, "Rectangle : Four" follows the same relationship.

As for the other options:

  • "Six : Hexagon" and "Five : Pentagon" also relate their number of sides to shape, So, these two options are wrong as they follow a reverse relationship.
  • "Triangle : Five" is incorrect because a triangle has three sides, not five.

Hence, the correct answer is "Rectangle : Four".

Words given on the left side of(::)are related with each other by some Logic/Rule /Relation. Select the missing word/word pair on the right side of(::)from the given alternatives based on the same Logic/Rule/Relation.

Ottawa : Canada :: ?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: The word on the left is the capital city of the country on the right side.

Ottawa: Canada

→ Ottawa is the capital city of Canada.

Let's check each option as per the logic,

1) Nairobi Kenya
2) Russia Moscow
3) Greece Athens
4) Spain Madrid

⇒ Here, we can see that only Option 1 follows the order and logic i.e., Nairobi is the capital city of Kenya.

Hence, the correct answer is "Nairobi: Kenya".
